g.title: SUPPLY
g.text: 230 V AC through M20 gland. Installation length excluded;

g.title: U7
g.text: Prototype; see boards.md. Mains under insulating cover. PE1
bonds backplate; JP1 bonds 5 V return to PE. Logical terminals;

g.title: FRONT
g.text: PE bond: ring terminal and serrated washer. Front plate also

g.title: J8
g.text: Zero 2 W physical pins: 5 V on 2, return on 6. Branch protection

g.title: U1
g.text: Adafruit 3006. C1 470 uF and C2 100 nF at VIN/GND. Signals:

g.title: U3
g.text: E4 deferred. Remove JD-VCC jumper. Strike: COM1/NO1; dry gate

g.title: U5
g.text: J52 backlight supply. Circuit: boards.md; logic: wiring-io.

g.title: JOUT1
g.text: effeff 118 A7. D1 at coil: cathode STRIKE+, anode STRIKE-.

g.title: JOUT2
g.text: Potential-free gate start contact; 30 V DC / 1 A design limit.
